# Synthetic CASTEP parser boundary fixtures

These files are deliberately minimal, synthetic text fixtures. They are not
copied from a user calculation, an official Materials Studio example, or a
CASTEP execution on this machine. They exist only to lock down fail-closed
classification boundaries in the private offline parser.

The P1 qualification report separately records two official success outputs as
read-only external observations. No real failure, timeout, cancellation, or
truncation output was available for lawful inclusion in this repository.
